landing.ar: يَرْفَعِ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مِنكُمْ وَالَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ دَرَجَاتٍ
landing.en: Allah will raise those who have believed among you and those who were given knowledge, by degrees.
landing.hadith: Whoever travels a path seeking knowledge, Allah makes easy for him a path to Paradise. — Muslim (approximate educational wording; confirm number with a teacher)

foundation.hadith: Ḥadīth Jibrīl — Islam, Īmān, Iḥsān. — Muslim

pillars.en: Seek help through patience and prayer.
pillars.hadith: The first of the servant’s deeds for which he will be brought to account on the Day of Resurrection will be his prayer. — verify collection · number · grade with a teacher

ihsan.ar: لَّقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ
ihsan.en: There has certainly been for you in the Messenger of Allah an excellent example.
ihsan.hadith: I was only sent to perfect noble character. — verify collection · number · grade

amanah.ar: ادْعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَالْمَوْعِظَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ
amanah.en: Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good instruction.
amanah.hadith: Convey from me, even if it is one āyah. — Bukhārī (confirm number with a teacher)
